capture.what: NEAR's own revenue dashboard: its capture over the last 30 days, as shares of gross fees, by mechanism

checks.detail: On the sampled days of 2025 the fees counted from single swaps come to 100.0% of the official fee figure for the same days.
checks.name: The official fee figure is what partners charge

checks.detail: The three wallets hold 399,756 NEAR more than 30 days earlier, about $1,299,767 at today's price, against $1,839,089 of official revenue. The gap includes price moves and anything the wallets paid out.
checks.name: The revenue wallets grew by about what the official revenue says

checks.detail: Over 30 days our archive-node balances show 405,284 NEAR arriving; SQL over the chain's transfer tables (a third party's saved Dune query) shows 405,283. The largest gap on any one day is under 1 NEAR.
checks.name: Two ways of reading the revenue wallets agree

checks.detail: It is a sum of volume per token, so a swap of Bitcoin for dollars is in it twice. Counting our partner swaps the same way (every swap that touches a token), we get 82% of the official BTC volume, 78% of the official SOL volume, 96% of the official XRP volume over 29 days. A one-sided official figure could not be matched this closely. So we compare partner swaps to the official total on the both-sides basis throughout.
checks.name: The official volume counts both sides of every swap

methodology.Fees: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Captured revenue held by the treasury before the 2026-02-23 buyback program.
methodology.Revenue: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Gross fees minus NEAR's captured revenue - the affiliate fees kept by solvers and third-party distribution channels (e.g. SwapKit).
